name: Suzumemo (kakeibo)
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm install >/dev/null && export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/$(cat .nvmrc)/bin:$PATH" && corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@11.1.2 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
start: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && (nvm install >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/$(cat .nvmrc)/bin:$PATH" && export CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous; pnpm exec convex dev --once || true; pnpm exec convex env get CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN >/dev/null 2>&1 || pnpm exec convex env set CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN "https://example-dev.clerk.accounts.dev" || true; pnpm exec convex env get APP_ENV >/dev/null 2>&1 || pnpm exec convex env set APP_ENV development || true; pnpm exec convex env get RECEIPT_IMAGE_EXTRACTOR_MODE >/dev/null 2>&1 || pnpm exec convex env set RECEIPT_IMAGE_EXTRACTOR_MODE mock || true; pnpm exec convex dev --once || true

terminals.name: convex
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/$(cat .nvmrc)/bin:$PATH" && export CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous && exec pnpm exec convex dev

terminals.name: vite
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/$(cat .nvmrc)/bin:$PATH" && exec pnpm exec vite --host 127.0.0.1
